title: Privacy notice
intro: This notice explains how Childhood is Now Ltd collects and uses your personal data when you use this website or get in touch with us, and the rights you have.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Childhood is Now Ltd is the data controller for the personal data described here. We are a private limited company registered in England and Wales (company number 16954121), with our registered office at 16 Upper Woburn Place, London, WC1H 0AF. You can contact us about this notice at info@childhoodisnow.co.uk.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: If you contact us through our website or by email, we collect the details you give us: your name, email address, phone number (if provided) and your message. If you tick the box to join our mailing list, we also keep a record of your consent.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your details to respond to your enquiry and, if we go on to work together, to manage that relationship. Our legal basis is our legitimate interest in responding to people who contact us.

If you join our mailing list, we use your email address to send you news updates. Our legal basis is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time using the unsubscribe link in any email or by contacting us.
We will never sell your data or use it for third-party marketing.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We only share your data with trusted service providers who help us run this website and our email, such as our website host. They process it on our behalf and only on our instructions. Where a provider processes data outside the UK, we make sure appropriate safeguards are in place.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep enquiries for up to two years after our last contact, unless we go on to work together, in which case we keep records for as long as we need to meet our legal and contractual obligations. We keep mailing list details until you unsubscribe.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use cookies to track you, and we do not use analytics or advertising cookies. If that changes, we will update this notice and ask for your consent where required.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to ask us to correct or delete it, to restrict or object to how we use it, and to receive a copy in a portable format. To use any of these rights, email info@childhoodisnow.co.uk.
If you are unhappy with how we have handled your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at www.ico.org.uk, although we would appreciate the chance to put things right first.

sections.heading: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: We may update this notice from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page.
